causal_rationale.statement: KRAS is a well-characterized RAS/MAPK driver in COADREAD with relatively high pathway activity (signaling-network-mechanism, pathway-activity-context), and the dependency concentrates in the hotspot-mutant stratum: a predominantly-clonal, likely-oncogenic missense hotspot in a frequently-altered oncogenic pathway (variant-level-interpretation, target-clonality, mutation-hotspot-frequency, oncogenic-pathway-alteration) drives a mutant-strongly-dependent state (mutation-stratified-dependency) that is triangulated across CRISPR, RNAi and PRISM with cross-consortium concordant-dependent, engaged calls (pan-cancer-crispr-dependency-distribution, pan-cancer-rnai-dependency-distribution, prism-crispr-concordance, cross-consortium-dependency). The dependency is lineage-selective and conditioned by the driver mechanism (dependency-lineage-selectivity). HOWEVER, this monotherapy dependency is tensioned by strong paralog-buffering and a moderately-concordant-NON-dependent baseline call, indicating the pan-lineage baseline is non-dependent and redundancy may blunt single-node inhibition (paralog-buffering, crispr-rnai-dependency-concordance). Expression does not underpin the dependency — target is not tumor-elevated with modest downregulation and only weak expression-dependency correlation (tumor-elevation-breadth, tumor-rna-vs-adjacent, expression-dependency-correlation, abundance-dependency).

therapeutic_hypothesis.statement: A mutant-selective small-molecule inhibitor of KRAS is the proposed modality, justified by a potent measured ligand, strong static structural features, and approved-drug tractability converging with clinical-precedent compound activity (measured-potency-tractability, structure-features-static, known-drug-tractability, prism-compound-activity). Small molecule is the only viable modality here: surface/ADC/TCE routes are dead (surface-modality neither_viable, not-surface, no-transmembrane per surfaceome-family-classification, protein-surface-evidence, surface-topology-and-ptm, adc-tce-modality-fit). The pharmacologic case is corroborated by mutant-strongly-drug-sensitive response aligning with the mutant-dependent stratum (mutation-drug-response, dependency-predictability). CRITICAL CAVEAT: monotherapy is threatened by strong paralog-buffering and a non-dependent baseline (paralog-buffering, crispr-rnai-dependency-concordance), which motivates a combination — and although a strong synthetic-lethal / combinatorial-dependency signal exists (combinatorial-dependency, synthetic-lethal-partners), NO actionable partner is mapped (partner-conditional-dependency = no_partner_mapped), so a specific combination pairing is UNSUPPORTED at present and cannot be operationalized. Degradation is a feasible alternative avenue (degradation-feasibility ubiquitination_substrate) if buffering defeats occupancy-based inhibition.

population.statement: The enrichable COADREAD population is hotspot-MUTANT KRAS, not amplified/overexpressed. The actionable biomarker is a top-1pct recurrent, predominantly-clonal, likely-oncogenic missense hotspot defining the mutant-strongly-dependent, mutant-strongly-drug-sensitive stratum (mutation-hotspot-frequency, target-clonality, variant-level-interpretation, mutation-stratified-dependency, mutation-drug-response). The amplified-overexpressed-strongly-dependent stratum does NOT define an enrichable population here because copy-number distribution is broadly neutral in COADREAD (amp-expr-stratified-dependency contradicted by copy-number-distribution); amplification is not a valid enrichment axis. Malignant-subset scRNA detection confirms tumor-cell expression (tumor-scrna-celltype-expression), and models are well-represented in lineage (recommended-models).
population.subtype_or_biomarker: KRAS hotspot missense mutation (e.g. G12/G13); NOT copy-number amplification

therapeutic_window.statement: The window is constrained but conditionally defensible. Broad normal-tissue expression, high gnomAD LoF constraint, essential-tissue liability, HIGH single-cell normal-tissue liability, LoF risk phenotype and autosomal-dominant loss genetics all flag risk of WT KRAS inhibition (normal-tissue-liability, gnomad-lof-constraint, modality-therapeutic-window, sc-normal-celltype-expression, gene-burden-safety, clingen-dosage), and the safety line reads WT_constraint_mechanism_mismatch (safety). CRITICALLY, this liability is MITIGATED, not resolved, IF the drug is mutant-selective: response concentrates in the missense-hotspot mutant stratum sparing WT (mutation-type-counts, mutation-drug-response), so a mutant-allele-selective inhibitor decouples efficacy from the constrained WT pool. Selectivity is otherwise unreconciled — tumor-vs-normal selectivity is discordant across comparators and only minimally enriched (tumor-vs-normal-selectivity, tumor-vs-normal-percentile-crossing), so the window rests entirely on mutant-allele pharmacologic selectivity rather than expression differential.

per_line.dimension: therapeutic_window / safety (WT mismatch vs mutant-selective rescue)

proposed_verdict_reason.value: The dependency is strong, triangulated, and biomarker-anchored to a top-1pct clonal missense hotspot, with small-molecule tractability well-established (mutation-stratified-dependency, prism-crispr-concordance, mutation-hotspot-frequency, measured-potency-tractability). Advancement is conditional on the mutant-hotspot biomarker because efficacy concentrates there and, critically, mutant-allele selectivity is the ONLY route to a defensible window given WT-constraint mechanism mismatch, high gnomAD constraint and broad normal-tissue liability (mutation-drug-response, gnomad-lof-constraint, modality-therapeutic-window, normal-tissue-liability). A deterministic safety gate may clamp this toward advanceable_flagged given the WT essential-tissue liability; the honest tensions are paralog-buffering-driven monotherapy escape and an unmapped combination partner (paralog-buffering, partner-conditional-dependency).

go_forth.next_evidence: Isogenic KRAS-mutant vs KRAS-WT COADREAD cell/organoid panel treated with the candidate mutant-selective small molecule, reading (a) mutant-allele selectivity index (potency shift mutant vs WT, to confirm the window rescue) and (b) durability of response under paralog-buffering pressure — i.e. whether HRAS/NRAS or feedback reactivation drives escape, and which co-targeted node restores full effect. This single experiment simultaneously tests the mutant-selective safety-window hypothesis (the gate-limiting question) AND maps the missing combination partner that partner-conditional-dependency=no_partner_mapped currently blocks.
go_forth.value_of_information: It resolves the two decision-changing unknowns at once: whether the constrained WT window is truly rescued by mutant selectivity (kill/confirm on safety gate) and whether monotherapy survives paralog-buffering or needs a now-unmapped partner (kill/confirm on efficacy durability). Both are the principal tensions gating advancement.
